answer: Only 76% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not forfeit. Because the haven ledger attributes every share, the zenith audit shows the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it pays the karst fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 20 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
